column1: # Forwarder variant registry, read by scripts/bench-forward.sh and copied
# into every run directory for forwarder-report. Tab-separated; "-" is an
# empty field; lines starting with "#" are comments.
# Columns: id, build_set (sync|tokio|async-io), binary, args, baseline id,
# offload (0|1), family, mode, runtime, layer, buffers, label.
# A baseline row (baseline "-") is raw tun-rs; every other row is compared
# with the baseline it names, measured in the same repetition.
